key_features: High-Speed Performance: Up to 1000MB/s read and 950MB/s write for quick file transfer.

Cross-Platform Compatibility: Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux – no driver needed.
Compact and Lightweight: Easy to carry in your pocket or small bag.
Durable Body: Built to handle everyday use and travel.
Low Power Usage: Doesn’t overheat and keeps your devices cool.
Smart Temperature Range: Works in 0°C to 70°C, stores safely from -40°C to 80°C.
